title: Pure Jurrac
summary: Jurrac cards only, with generic staples; the page's wider Dinosaur engine is left out. The 2025 cards are the deck. Jurrac Stego destroys one of your cards and sends a Dinosaur from the Deck to the GY, then summons Jurracs from the hand or Deck whose Levels add up to the sent monster's, ignoring their conditions, so sending Jurrac Titano can put Titano itself on the field. Jurrac Megalo summons itself next to a Dinosaur, swaps two cards for two, and mills a Jurrac when destroyed. Jurrac Volcano turns each Jurrac you destroy into a fresh one from the Deck. Jurrac Astero, a Level 10 Synchro, sets a Jurrac Spell/Trap, negates a Special Summon and becomes Jurrac Meteor on the opponent's turn. Older Jurracs are here mostly as Levels for Stego to add up.
